description.value: The caster emulates Zalera’s use of his dark magic to make healing effects harmful at all enemies within 30 ft of you with a total HD that is a multiple of 4 must make a Will save or gain the Reversed status effect and have healing effects damage them for 4d3 turns. Reversed: This status effect causes the target to take damage from healing spells and effects, including Fast Healing and Regeneration. Learned From Zalera .
